title: ✂️ Paper & Pastries: A Junk Journaling Social
description:
Spend some downtime with us and get creative by junk journaling while enjoying sweet treats and a build-your-own cold brew bar. 

Bring your own journal, notebook or scrapbook, and supplies to share if you'd like! We'll provide a selection of collage materials, creative supplies, deserts, and everything you need for a cozy afternoon of making. 

Your ticket includes:
☕ Build-your-own cold brew bar with creamers, sweet foams, and toppings
🍰 A selection of pastries and sweet treats
✂️ Shared journaling and collage supplies
✨ A welcoming space to create, chat, and unwind
Come solo or bring a friend. This is your invitation to step away from the screen, slow down, and spend a few hours creating something real.
Optional: Add on a Locally Made Trifle
We have trifles available to add to your ticket from Curated Table. We are providing a selection of pastries and sweet treats as part of your standard ticket, but if you would like to support another local business, you can reach out to me for more dessert and snack options!
